senses.gloss: m. (σχολαστικός, scholasticus; S.; D. C.) scholasticus = causidicus, advocate, pleader.
units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Berakhot 4:2:6">Y. Ber. IV, 7ᵈ</cite>; cmp.
